Questions 1–10

Complete the notes below.

Write NO MORE THAN ONE WORD OR A NUMBER for each answer.

Name of the hotel: Hotel
signboard: the needs to be bigger
swimming pool: to be relocated from the to the
resting area: turn the room into reception
translation needed:
current colour:
Construction: starts before
Manager's name: Barron
Telephone number:

transcript.en: Hello. Shining Decorations. How can I help you?
transcript.zh: 你好。闪亮装修公司。请问需要帮助吗？

transcript.en: Hello. We are thinking of renovating our hotel this year.
transcript.zh: 你好。我们在考虑今年给我们的酒店重新装修。

transcript.en: It was built 15 years ago, and it’s quite old now. So I’m calling to see if your company can do that.
transcript.zh: 它建于15 年前，现在已经很旧了。所以我打电话来看看你们公司能不能做。

transcript.en: Oh, yes. We do all kinds of decoration and renovation projects.
transcript.zh: 当然。我们做各种装修翻修工程。

transcript.en: Last month, we just renovated the city library. The client was really pleased with the outcome.
transcript.zh: 上个月，我们刚刚翻新了市图书馆。客户对结果非常满意。

transcript.en: Oh really? I heard that one was pretty tough, but the new library does get a fresh look.
transcript.zh: 哦，真的吗？听说那个翻新挺难的，不过新图书馆确实焕然一新。

transcript.en: Yes, it was a tough one. Hmm, may I have the name of your hotel?
transcript.zh: 是的，确实挺难。嗯，可以问问你们酒店的名字吗？

transcript.en: Yes, it’s Central Hotel.
transcript.zh: 可以，是中央酒店。

transcript.en: Should I tell you about some changes we want to make before you come and check it out?
transcript.zh: 在你们来检查之前，我是否应该和你说说我们想要做的改变？

transcript.en: Yes, please. I will write them down. Just a moment, please....
transcript.zh: 当然，请说。我会写下来。请稍等一下....

transcript.en: OK. What are the changes you want to make?
transcript.zh: 好了。你们想做哪些改变？

transcript.en: First, the address on our signboard in the front of the hotel is not big enough.
transcript.zh: 首先，我们酒店门前招牌上的地址不够大。

transcript.en: We would like to have it enlarged.
transcript.zh: 我们想把它放大。

transcript.en: I see. It’s important for the guests to see the information clearly. No problem.
transcript.zh: 明白。让客人清楚地看到信息很重要。没问题。

transcript.en: OK. Next is our swimming pool. It’s now in the basement.
transcript.zh: 好的。接下来是我们的游泳池。现在的位置是在地下室。

transcript.en: Our guests are not very happy about it. After talking to the designers, we’ve decided to move it to the roof of the hotel.
transcript.zh: 我们的客人对此并不满意。和设计师商量后，我们决定把它换到酒店的屋顶。

transcript.en: Oh. That’s a big change, as it’ll be an outdoor site, but I believe it’s a wonderful idea.
transcript.zh: 这是一个大变化，因为这样它就是一个户外泳池了，但我相信这是一个绝妙的主意。

transcript.en: Yes. Our hotel is right beside a river, so it’s got a good view from up there.
transcript.zh: 是的。我们的酒店就在河边，所以从上面可以看到很好的景色。

transcript.en: That’s true. I’m sure more people would stay at your hotel because of it, it’s a very competitive feature. We can do that for you.
transcript.zh: 对。我相信更多的人会因此而住你们酒店，这是一个非常有竞争力的特色。我们可以做到。

transcript.en: We have a big lounge on the ground floor, where our guests can rest.
transcript.zh: 我们在一楼有一个大休息室，我们的客人可以在那里休息。

transcript.en: We don’t think we are making the most of it. And my manager said we should use the room for reception.
transcript.zh: 我们认为我们没有充分利用它。我的经理说我们应该把这个空间利用起来做接待。

transcript.en: The old one is too small.
transcript.zh: 老接待处太小了。

transcript.en: So you don’t need an area for guests to rest?
transcript.zh: 所以你不需要客人休息的地方？

transcript.en: Hmm, the hall will serve the purpose.
transcript.zh: 嗯，大厅可以给客人休息。

transcript.en: Alright. I’ve written it down. Anything else?
transcript.zh: 好的。我已经写下来了。还有别的吗？

transcript.en: Let me see. I think the words on the notice board should be translated. But I’ll need to confirm with my supervisor if we need to translate into Chinese or not. We have quite a lot of Chinese guests now.
transcript.zh: 让我看看。我认为布告栏上的文字应该翻译一下。但是我需要和我的主管确认一下是否需要翻译成中文。我们现在有很多中国客人。

transcript.en: But, Spanish translation is definitely needed. German is not necessary, neither is Japanese.
transcript.zh: 但是，西班牙语翻译肯定需要的。德语不是必须的，日语也不是。

transcript.en: We don’t have many guests from those countries.
transcript.zh: 来自这些国家的客人不多。

transcript.en: OK. I’ll just need to go and see how to plan the layout later.
transcript.zh: 好的。我需要看看怎么计划结构。

transcript.en: Yes, please. we don’t know if we should upgrade the design of the price board or not.
transcript.zh: 好的。我们不知道要不要升级价格牌的设计。

transcript.en: It looks a bit old-fashioned.
transcript.zh: 看起来有点老土了

transcript.en: What color is it?
transcript.zh: 什么颜色？

transcript.en: It’s red. I was wondering if white looks better.
transcript.zh: 红色。我在想，白色是不是更好看。

transcript.en: It’s hard to tell unless we see it in person.
transcript.zh: 除非我们亲眼看到，否则很难判断。

transcript.en: OK. When can the construction team come and start their work?
transcript.zh: 好的。施工队什么时候可以来开工？

transcript.en: Well, we are currently working on another project, but we think we can finish the work there sometime in June.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我们目前正在做另一个项目，但我们认为我们可以在六月的某个时间完成那里的工程。

transcript.en: So we can come before July. And it depends on how much time you have for the renovation project.
transcript.zh: 所以我们可以在七月之前来。而且这取决于你有多少时间来进行翻新项目。

transcript.en: If it’s quite urgent, we’ll need to discuss the starting time.
transcript.zh: 如果很急，我们需要讨论开始时间。

transcript.en: Hmm, we hope to start early, but it’s not too urgent.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我们希望早点开始，但不是太急。

transcript.en: We will wait till the end of the peak season.
transcript.zh: 我们将等到旺季结束。

transcript.en: Yeah, you don’t want to miss the peak time right now.
transcript.zh: 是啊，你不会想错过现在的高峰期。

transcript.en: So who should I contact for the initial check and evaluation?
transcript.zh: 那么我应该联系谁进行初步检查和评估？

transcript.en: You can call my manager, his name is Cliffton Barron.
transcript.zh: 你可以打电话给我的经理，他的名字是克利夫顿·巴伦。

transcript.en: Excuse me, how do you spell his first name?
transcript.zh: 不好意思，你怎么拼他的名字？

transcript.en: C-L-I-F-F-T-O-N.
transcript.zh: C-L-I-F-F-T-O-N。

transcript.en: And his phone number?
transcript.zh: 还有他的电话号码是？

transcript.en: It’s 093036602. You can call during work hours.
transcript.zh: 093036602。你可以在工作时间来电。

transcript.en: Got it. As for the contract details and the cost of the project, should I contact him or...?
transcript.zh: 好的。至于合同细节和工程费用，我应该联系他还是...？

transcript.en: Yes, you can talk to him for all these details.
transcript.zh: 是的，你可以和他谈所有这些细节。

transcript.en: Okay, thanks!
transcript.zh: 好的，谢谢！
